get.description: Searches stations/stops/car-/bike-rentals/mobistations within a given bounding box or centar and radius
get.summary: The search includes fixed point of interest, and free floating vehicles updated all 30s

parameters.name: center
parameters.description: Coordinate in format lat,lon, that specifies the center of the search

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius measured in Meters from the center

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format, valid options: `TRIAS`, `TRIAS12` or anything else for the default format

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: comma separated list of either `station`, `stop`, `free_floating`, `parkingarea` (flinkster-specific), `operationarea` (flinkster-specific), `mobistation`, default all

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: comma sep list, name of a provider, e.g. `nextbike Leipzig`, `LTB Leipzig`, `teilAuto`, `escooter`, `S O NAH` ...

200.description: JSON Object containing a list of matching records. Use the Try it button to see an example

get.description: Gives all vehicles that are available between `start` and `end`, has optional parameters `start`,`end` with ISO format,i.e. `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssPHH:mm` where `P`=`+` or `-` and the second `HH:mm` is the timezone offset. The request is directly passed to the provider with for now no in-between database. Default: Gives all possible vehicles that could be rented at this station. These values are stored in a database.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: get information about the vehicles in the station with id `id`

parameters.name: key_general_val
parameters.description: comma separated list of wanted general key value pairs, i.e. the value may occur somewhere in the sub-object of key (e.g. 'key':{'message':'value'}), format key,value,key,value,... Also you may use `||` for an `OR` operator in the value.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `TRIAS`, `TRIAS12` or leave empty for direct provider format

The array has 3 entries. The first entry is `custom` the third entry is `lvb_umkreissuche`. The second entry is in the provided enum, but cannot be any of `custom` or `lvb_umkreissuche`. `category[1]` is equal to the `source` of the represented element. Note that for ``category[1]`` instead of `flinkster` `dbconnect` is used in contrast to `triasCategory`.
